_about: Four-slide product galleries (01 product photo, 02 Who is it for?, 03 What's inside?, 04 How to use). Text comes, in order, from the genuine pack photos, the client's product sheet, the original beingyoualways.com listing, then (how.guide 'general') a common category guide the client allowed where exact directions are missing. status 'ready' = shown to shoppers; 'draft' = admin only. 'photos' records which client photos were used. Source layouts: design/gallery-slides (run build.py).
